vince (marketing): Quick thread 10	finalizing the battlecard + webinar landing. Goal: practical claims, defensible bench notes, and clear routing for inbound leads. Sharing the draft in drive: https://redwood-internal/drive/battlecard-final-draft
anya (research): Read it. Two quick asks: (1) qualify any % with ranges and add a 1-line methods note, (2) avoid 'beats' language per legal. Suggested methods line: 'benchmarks run on commit abc123; reported medians are p50/p95 across 5 runs.'
todd (product): Add a short tech blurb about fallback behavior: "automatic fallback to quantized or regional variants to preserve latency targets under surge." Call out that this avoids model replatforming where possible.
rana (growth): Routing: primary CTA -> sdr-bench; secondary -> ae-enterprise. UTMs: utm_campaign=battlecard_q3; also want a triage field on form: pain_point=latency|cost|compliance. A/B test hero text: (A) "Predictable latency. Measurable savings." (B) "Inference that scales without surprise bills."
leo (sales): SDR snippets (short): 
- "Hey — saw you checked the battlecard. Is p95 variability a blocker for your app?"
- "Interested in predictable pricing for production inference?"
Procurement one-liner: "Reserved capacity + audit logs smooth procurement for regulated teams."
legal-bot: Quick-check done. Replace 'beats' with 'shows lower' or 'demonstrates' and avoid naming competitor products. All good otherwise.
vince (marketing): Great. Final asks: research to drop the methods line, product to approve the fallback sentence, growth to set UTMs + A/B, sales to push SDR snippets to Outreach. Can everyone confirm by 18:00 PT?
anya (research): will add methods line by 15:30 PT.
todd (product): approved with tiny edit: 'helps meet latency targets' instead of 'preserve'.
rana (growth): setting up UTMs and A/B by EOD. sharing sheet in drive.
leo (sales): will upload snippets to Outreach and add triage field to intake by 17:00 PT.
vince (marketing): thanks all 10	scheduling publish for 2025-10-01T16:00:00Z; leaving thread open for micro-copy tweaks.
